name: XLM Price Oracle Updater
description: Pushes the latest XLM/USDC spot price from an off-chain feed into a Soroban oracle contract once per minute. The oracle contract emits a price_updated event containing the new price and the ledger sequence at which it was recorded.
author: example-org

params.name: price
params.doc: Latest XLM/USDC price scaled to 7 decimal places (1 XLM = 1_0000000 units).

params.name: source
params.doc: Identifier of the off-chain price source, e.g. "coinbase".

dataFields.name: price
dataFields.doc: The price value that was written.

dataFields.name: ledger
dataFields.doc: Ledger sequence at which the price was recorded.
